steps.js: async function waitFor(f,n){for(let i=0;i<n;i++){const r=f(); if(r) return r; await new Promise(x=>setTimeout(x,1000));} return null;} const vis=e=>e.offsetWidth||e.offsetHeight; const pick=()=>{for(const sel of ['button','a','[role=button]','span','div']){const e=[...document.querySelectorAll(sel)].find(e=>vis(e)&&/update location/i.test(e.innerText||e.getAttribute('aria-label')||'')&&(e.innerText||'x').length<60); if(e) return e;} return null;}; const b=await waitFor(pick,15); if(!b) return 'no update location'; b.click(); let z=await waitFor(()=>document.querySelector('#zipCode, input[name=zipCode], input[placeholder*=zip i]'),8); if(!z){b.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('click',{bubbles:true})); z=await waitFor(()=>document.querySelector('#zipCode, input[name=zipCode], input[placeholder*=zip i]'),6);} return (z?'zip box ready ':'no zip box ')+b.tagName+' '+(b.innerText||'').trim().slice(0,40)+' | inputs='+[...document.querySelectorAll('input')].filter(vis).map(i=>i.id||i.name||i.placeholder).join(',')
